scope: Outcome-free applicability audit of existing public RoboArena records for the H165 routing action; not a benchmark-validity, outcome, assignment-intent, causal, or field claim.

units.evidence: No audited public record declares policy routing within a presented pair as the downstream action.
units.name: declared_within_pair_routing_action

units.evidence: The pinned public UI declares a Policy Leaderboard and names Bradley-Terry Davidson in UI prose.
units.name: declared_global_leaderboard_or_ranking

units.evidence: The H165 within-pair routing action is not the public global-ranking action.
units.name: h165_action_aligned_with_public_action

units.evidence: The paper describes random pair sampling before evaluator task/scene construction; deployed execution is unaudited.
units.name: paper_pair_first_random_sampling

units.evidence: The audited authored public source does not establish the server assignment law.
units.name: current_deployed_pair_assignment_law

units.evidence: Neither pair inclusion probabilities nor deterministic assignment weights are public in the audited record.
units.name: fixed_outcome_independent_pair_weights

units.evidence: The paper anticipates a changing pool but does not establish active-pool intervals for a public dump.
units.name: active_pool_effective_intervals

units.evidence: The paper source record explicitly leaves a session-level assignment export unestablished.
units.name: session_level_assignment_export

units.evidence: The paper requires closely matched initial conditions inside each A/B comparison.
units.name: matched_within_pair_conditions

units.evidence: No audited source identifies a stable future distribution G_ab for evaluator-constructed tasks and scenes.
units.name: stable_future_pair_specific_context_law

units.evidence: No overlap, invariance, or transport bridge links historical realized contexts to a future G_ab.
units.name: historical_to_future_context_bridge

units.evidence: The independently reconstructed February public panel has 1,816 exact-two sessions and all 21 fixed-policy pairs.
units.name: cumulative_february_panel_all_21_edges

units.evidence: The newest increment has 278 exact-two sessions, 15 of 21 pairs, and one isolated fixed policy.
units.name: newest_nonoverlapping_increment_all_21_edges

units.evidence: Public topology and vocabulary shift require segmentation or an explicit bridge before pooling.
units.name: stable_roster_assignment_epoch_for_pooling

units.evidence: Public metadata support session-level descriptive counts, but the relied-on challenge retained neither assignment rows nor session identifiers.
units.name: future_cluster_lifecycle_structure
